_comment: Example .mcp.json for a project you code on with yk-copilot. Copy it to the root
Every MCP tool definition is re-sent on every single request, so the tool list is
charged against NUM_CTX before the model reads a word of your actual question. A
server exposing hundreds of tools fills a 32k window on its own and leaves nothing
for the conversation. Against a local model, keep this file to the servers the task
actually needs — that is the whole rule.
ollos gives the model eyes and ears locally: it transcribes audio, reads text off
screenshots and video frames, and diffs frames. Unlike MODEL_VISION in the proxy, it
returns text, so nothing has to fit in VRAM alongside the code model.
